plate.title: B06 · Corner fleurons and pearl centres
plate.description: Small local enrichments lead. Paired finite leaflets grow at selected published turns and edge landmarks; buds, pearls or small trefoils punctuate the surviving repeat. The large medallions from the intermediate design are absent. The same skeleton remains, but the introduced path set is deliberately different.
